verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents API keys, including agent self-signup that creates an account and key, and per-user API keys on the self-hosted server. None of the evidence describes limiting a key's permissions, scopes, read/write rights or resources to least privilege. Entity-scoped memory partitions data by user, agent or app; it is not a credential-scoping control, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
